messages:
alex: Quick handoff note for OrchidMed prelaunch this weekend — asking for oncall coverage and a short watch. High-level: VIP customer, reserved Dedicated capacity but expected spike during their integration test windows. tagging @jamie for primary cover. :wave:

alex: Key times: Sat 22:00-01:00 UTC (integration smoke), Tue 22:00-23:30 UTC (load test). Please keep an eye on latency >200ms p95 and error rate >1%.

maria: Adding slack FYI — Product says they may run a burst script during the Tue window up to 3x normal qps. Any known throttles? :thinking:

simon: We have dedicated pools pinned for them, but autoscale policy has a slow cooldown. If we see sustained queue growth > 30s, manual scale recommended. I left a runbook snippet in ops-runbooks/orchidmed.md.

alex: Thanks. Manual scaling steps for oncall: `rdctl scale pool orchidmed-pool --replicas N` (need infra perms). If you don't have perms ping infra oncall.

jamie: I can take primary for Sat night and Tue load. I have perms. Can someone post the exact metrics dashboards?

ops-bot: Dashboard links: https://console.redwood/metrics/orchidmed-latency https://console.redwood/metrics/orchidmed-queue-length (auto-posted)

maria: Quick heads-up on SLA: their contract has a 99.9% availability clause during launch windows. If we hit degradations we should notify sales+customer promptly. Prep an incident channel just in case: `#orchidmed-launch` — created.

alex: Good call. If there's a model fallback we should enable the smaller-quantized variant to keep latency. Simon — confirm fallback chain is enabled?

simon: Fallbacks are enabled: orchid-v2-16g -> orchid-v2-8g-q4 -> orchid-v1-legacy. There is a routing policy to prefer lower-cost variants only under capacity pressure. I'll remove the 'cost-prefer' flag for the Tue window so we fallback faster to compatible variants.

jamie: Copy. I'll be on pager and will do pre-check at Tue 21:30 UTC to validate routes and run a quick spike test (`curl -X POST https://api.redwood/infer -d '{"prompt":"test"}'`).

deploy-bot: Scheduled load test job created: team:orchidmed, start: 2025-11-18T22:00:00Z, est qps:3x normal. Job id: LT-8243.

alex: One more risk note: their integration client uses long-session streaming; watch for KV cache memory pressure. If memory > 80% on any node, restart to clear stuck sessions. Ops-runbook has the exact command.

maria: I'll draft a short customer-facing update template in #product. If anything happens we'll use that to brief them. :thumbsup:

jamie: All set on my side. Will post a short post-check summary after each window.

alex: Thanks team. If anyone needs to swap coverage DM me. Otherwise handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
